subject: Re: Recent latency spikes — options for SLA upgrade and credits
messages:
From: Lena Morales <lena@sedgwell.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Latency spikes last week — impact and next steps

Hi Karthik,

We had several requests time out and two customer-facing flows that experienced latency > 4s on Tuesday (06/01). Our ops team put together a short incident timeline (attached). These incidents affected two production teams and we saw an increase in error budgets for our nightly jobs.

We need to understand:
- What caused the spike and whether you can guarantee this won't recur.
- Whether we can get credits for the impacted window.
- What it would take to move Sedgwell to your premium SLA tier (we need 99.95% uptime and tighter p99 latency targets).

We have a renewal conversation starting next month; if we can see a clear path to a higher SLA and a short pilot for dedicated capacity, we will consider expanding to an additional 3 teams.

Can we schedule a call this week to discuss concrete options?

Thanks,
Lena Morales
Head of Product Operations
Sedgwell Financial

Attachment: incident_timeline_sedgewell_20260602.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Lena Morales <lena@sedgwell.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Latency spikes last week — impact and next steps

Hi Lena — thanks for the write-up and the timeline. I'm really sorry you saw that impact. I reviewed the timeline with our SREs and product infra team. Short summary: we had an autoscaling edge condition combined with a KV cache eviction event that caused a brief increase in tail latency during a high-concurrency batch. The root cause is patched and we pushed a mitigation yesterday that prevents the eviction cascade.

Options we can offer immediately:
1) One-time service credit for the impacted billing window (we can propose 10-20% depending on verification).
2) Fast-track to Redwood Premium (99.95% SLA) via a 90-day dedicated pilot — includes reserved capacity, dedicated bursting, and an onboarding SRE runbook. We can prioritize your onboarding and assign a named SRE for the pilot.
3) If you prefer no infra changes, we can apply conservative throttling/partitioning settings to reduce p99 latency while we complete the pilot.

I'll schedule a 30-minute call today at 3pm PT if that works; Monica from our security/onboarding will join to answer questions about SOC2/artifacts.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm which option you want explored (pilot vs. credits)
- If pilot, I will send a one-page offer and HubSpot deal with formal terms + DocuSign link

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Latency spikes last week — options for SLA upgrade and credits

Monica / Evelyn — forwarding Lena's note. She flagged renewals next month and expansion if we can offer a clear premium path. Thoughts on concessions we can make in the offer? My initial thinking: 90-day pilot on Redwood Premium with reserved capacity + named SRE, and 15% credit for the impacted window. Ask for a 3-month commitment to the pilot at a blended price (pilot discount) and then convert to a standard Dedicated contract if pilot shows improvement.

Key asks for approval:
- Approve 15% service credit and pilot discount (we can scale the discount by region).
- Approve named SRE support being included as part of pilot (we can limit to 30 hours).
- If procurement pushes for legal redlines, we may need a quick review turn (48 hours).

Lena is open to expansion to 3 more teams if we move quickly.

Thanks,
Karthik

If we get verbal buy-in on the pilot today, we'll fast-track the offer.

Evelyn

Offer summary:
- 90-day Redwood Premium pilot (reserved capacity + 99.95% SLA commitment for pilot traffic), named SRE support (up to 30 hours), weekly performance checkpoints.
- One-time service credit: 15% of June invoice (applies to the impacted billing window after verification).
- Pilot pricing: 30% discount off Published Dedicated rate for the 90-day pilot. On successful conversion, standard Dedicated list pricing applies; migration credit equal to the pilot discount applied once.
- Success criteria: p99 latency under 750ms for production requests above agreed baseline and <0.1% error rate during the pilot window.
- Timeline: onboarding within 10 business days of signature; pilot starts upon onboarding completion.
